description: This file manages diagnostic session states, including session data structures, pruning logic, and state retrieval functions.

methods.name: pruneDiagnosticSessionStates
methods.description: Removes old or idle session states based on TTL, size, and interval constraints.

methods.name: resolveSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves a session key from a SessionRef, prioritizing sessionKey, then sessionId, then 'unknown'.

methods.name: findStateBySessionId
methods.description: Finds a session state by sessionId among the stored session states.

methods.name: getDiagnosticSessionState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a session state based on a SessionRef.

methods.name: getDiagnosticSessionStateCountForTest
methods.description: Returns the current number of session states for testing purposes.

methods.name: resetDiagnosticSessionStateForTest
methods.description: Clears all session states and resets pruning timestamp for testing.
